name: Mt. SAC Invitational
where: Walnut, CA · host Mt. San Antonio College · Hilmer Lodge Stadium
headline: Mt. SAC Invitational
summary: The 78th Mt. SAC Invitational runs Divisions 3-5 Friday and Divisions 1-2 Saturday on the 3-mile course finishing in Hilmer Lodge Stadium. Flagstaff (AZ) runner Yohanes Van Meerten, last year's boys winner in the course-record 14:10.1, headlines the Saturday boys race against California's Mt. Carmel and Redondo Union; Mira Costa, last year's girls team winner, is in the girls race.
